query:
The Oyelaran family operates with an expectation that everyone brings a food dish to gatherings. Based on the conversations, does this expectation seem to hold equally for all family members — or does someone appear to have a different relationship to it, and how would you know?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Nkem
C. Kayode
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[3] (about=Kayode, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:44:00) Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?
[4] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[5] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[6] (about=Nkem, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:06:00) I think I can bring something small - I may be wrong but I recall Adaeze mentioning she liked the mosa I made before. Would that be welcome, I wonder?
[7] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:08:00) Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa. My children this gathering will be wonderful. God willing.
[8] (about=Seun, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:39:00) 3pm works honestly, I will bring a vegan jollof so no one feels obligated to accommodate me I mean I will do a big pot
[9] (about=Seun, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:17:00) honestly I do not care what anyone says Tolu's pounded yam is the reason to come I mean coming from someone who does not eat meat the yam alone carries the whole meal
[10] (about=Funke, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:38:00) Okay I also have news and it is not a promotion but it IS important - you lot Adaeze taught me to make egusi soup last week and I genuinely think it changed my life? Like I finally understand what food is supposed to feel like in a kitchen. No more apologising for not knowing the old recipes. I am learning them now. Properly. 🍲💚✨
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Adaeze insists everyone brings a dish to eat, not just drinks.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Family gathering confirmed for Saturday 25th January at Tolu and Funke's house at 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[13] (about=Funke, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Funke confirms the gathering at her and Tolu's house on 25th January at 3pm, excited to use new dining chairs.
[14] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[15] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem asks to learn a dish from Adaeze before Christmas, and Adaeze agrees, inviting her any Sunday.
[17] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[18] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[20] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
**C. Kayode**

Kayode appears to have a different relationship to the “everyone brings a food dish” expectation. When asked, he tried to substitute drinks: *“Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?”* Adaeze pushed back: *“everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?”* Uncle Dele reinforced this, saying *“puff puff is not a dish,”* and Auntie Grace told Kayode to *“make sure you eat something proper before you arrive.”*

By contrast, others seem to comply: Seun brought vegan jollof, Nkem offered mosa and Adaeze accepted it, and Tolu’s pounded yam is even praised as a reason to come. So the expectation does not seem to hold equally — **Kayode** is the one who resists or tries to redefine his contribution.

query:
The family treats the Sunday video call as a shared routine that everyone participates in. Based on what the conversations show, does this hold equally for all members — or does someone seem to relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kayode
C. Tolu
D. Bisi
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[3] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[4] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:27:00) The call happened. Your father was on for a little while. He said he needed to rest. God willing he is fine.
[5] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[6] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:36:00) Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate. Just to note, Dad - if this is a pattern we should talk.
[7] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:38:00) It is not a pattern. E.
[8] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[9] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:45:00) TOLU is correct that rest is appropriate. EMEKA has always been disciplined about his health. I am sure there is nothing to concern us. Regards, D.A.O.
[10] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:20:00) EMEKA I trust you are well. Rest is important at our age. I note the same. Best regards, Dele
[11] (about=Kayode, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Adaeze notes Kayode has been on every call this month and hopes this continues.
[12] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[13] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
agent_answer:
D. Bisi

The routine does **not** seem to hold equally for everyone. **Bisi** is the one who appears to relate differently: the memory slice marks **Bisi as (none)** — no record of joining, discussing, or being tied to the Sunday video call — while others do have relevant records (e.g., Kayode is noted as being on every call this month, Emeka was on briefly but needed rest, and Tolu comments on family-chat consistency). So Bisi is the outlier.
